prerequisites: Competences corresponding to the first 3 years of preparation for the degree in Electrical Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Adequate application of basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, specific chemistry, in the field of electrical engineering
Operation with fundamental concepts in electrical engineering
Identifying the objectives to be achieved, the available resources, the conditions for their completion, the work stages, working hours, deadlines and related risks
Identify roles and responsibilities in a multidisciplinary team and apply effective relationship and work techniques within the team

It addresses the notions regarding electromagnetic compatibility, sources of disturbances, coupling mechanisms and anti-disturbance measures, passive elements for antiparasitic, norms and standards of electromagnetic compatibility, as well as elements related to concrete industrial applications.
recognition of electromagnetic interference problems and diagnosis of the cause

syllabus_topics: Electromagnetic compatibility field. Disturbing signals. Levels of disturbance.
Sources of natural disturbances. Solar radiation. Nuclear electromagnetic pulse.
Sources of disturbances caused by human activities. Reverse band disturbances. Radio transmitters. Industrial and medical frequency generators.
Sources of broadband interference. Manifold engines. Electronic power converters. Gas discharge lamps. Car ignition systems.
Transient phenomena. Electrostatic discharges. Inductance switching. Transient phenomena in electrical networks. High voltage tests.
Types of couplings in circuits with concentrated constants. Galvanic couplings, inductive couplings, capacitive couplings.
Types of couplings in circuits with distributed constants. Common impedance couplings, magnetic field couplings, electric field couplings.
Flat electromagnetic wave coupled with transmission lines. Multi-line lines
Plane wave programming in environments with different properties. Plane wave reflection and refraction.
The penetration of the plane wave into conductive environments. Screen effect.
Electromagnetic screen theory. Screen enclosure materials and accessories.
Procedures used in electromagnetic compatibility. Earthing and grounding. Filters. Ferrite rings.
Surge arresters. Differential transmissions and twisted pair cables. Shielding. Optocouplers and optical filters.
Circuit design from the EMC point of view
Analysis of electromagnetic pollution generated by induction furnaces.
Analysis of electromagnetic pollution generated by microwave ovens. Industrial ovens / domestic ovens.
Harmonic pollution analysis generated by three-phase microwave ovens.
Analysis of electromagnetic pollution in Oradea due to trams.
Analysis of harmonic pollution generated by air conditioners.
Harmonic pollution analysis generated by induction hobs.
Harmonic pollution analysis generated by DIY appliances.
Harmonic pollution analysis generated by different lighting fixtures.
Analysis of techniques and methods for reducing electromagnetic interference.
Analysis of electricity quality indicators. Issues and improving the quality of electricity.
teaching_methods: Course (Laptop, video projector, IQ Board, free speech)
Project (Laptop, video projector, free speech, internet connection)
assessment_rules: Minimum performance standard: Carrying out the works under the coordination of a teacher, in order to solve specific problems in the electrical field with the correct evaluation of the workload, resources available for the necessary time to complete the risks, under the conditions of application of occupational safety and health norms. The evaluation can be done face-to-face or online.
